mask: Teacher targets only for leg joints with raw teacher and parent targets inside the same frozen mechanical range and absolute teacher-minus-parent output no larger than 0.08 rad. Copy the parent raw target for all other outputs. Same teacher sensor observations, action history, and command clocks for both labels. Preserve a separate four-pose parent-success replay.
scope: Build and hash stored observations and same-input labels for a future equal-budget offline imitation control. This phase does not perform optimization or simulation. Require coverage and bounded nonzero supervision in both development archives before training preparation.
